source: Source: USGS Comprehensive Catalog (ComCat), earthquakes of magnitude 4 or more; dates in UTC. Before 1973 the catalogue holds only larger earthquakes (magnitude 5 or more here); from 1973 it includes smaller ones, and detection has improved since, so counts across decades are not like for like: the magnitude 5 view is the fairer comparison, though it too is thinner before the mid-1960s. Magnitudes are of mixed types (mostly mb, also Mw and Ms). Epicentres can be 10 km or more out, so the district is approximate. Depth: shallow means under 70 km; some poorly located events are given a standard shallow depth. Boundaries: geoBoundaries, illustrative. Updated automatically every day.
